decided: The instruction now tells the AI to write no decision record during a walk of an archived change, and says so as a known limit, instead of directing it at a write orbit refuses.
alternatives: let orbit write decision records into an archived change's history, which is new mechanism this change did not review
why: Orbit keeps decision records in the history of work while it is live, and does not write them to an archived change; the instruction should match what orbit does rather than send the AI into a refusal.
detail: External system pass W2; the engine's ledger/stop/resolution scopes carry no archived fallback (src/core/emit-composition.ts COMMANDS).
